units.source_text: 围成圆阵吹笛的人，不论王侯公卿或平民，都选用精通此道、世有定评的专家。

en.t: For those who formed a circle and played the flutes, whether princes, nobles, or commoners, experts skilled in this art and long recognized by public opinion were chosen.

units.source_text: 宰相二人与左卫门督、右卫门督分别指挥左右乐（唐乐与高丽乐）。

en.t: Two councillors, together with the captains of the Left and Right Gate Guards, respectively directed the music of the left and right, that is, Tang music and Korean music.

units.source_text: 舞人也都选用世间最优秀的能手，预先笼闭在邸宅中分别练习，然后参与表演。

en.t: The dancers, too, were chosen from the finest performers in the world; they were first kept enclosed in their residences to practice separately, and then took part in the performance.
